rows.section: General Rules / Privacy and data-protection baseline
rows.text: The Privacy Ceiling is derived from the strongest compatible protection required across the supported United States jurisdictions, the United Kingdom and the European Union/EEA, plus deliberate engineering headroom. The implementation MUST maintain a versioned LegalPrivacyProfile describing the currently applicable statutory/regulatory requirements for each supported jurisdiction. Where multiple requirements are compatible, the most protective requirement becomes the global default. Where applicable laws genuinely conflict, the exception MUST be narrowly jurisdiction-scoped, documented, legally reviewed and MUST NOT lower protection for unaffected users or data.
